message:
You know those moments when you feel a bit smug because you’ve been prepared for something? Well, with all this talk about upcoming storms and heat waves, I figured it was time to revisit some old notes on staying cool and safe. I found a handy resource that’s a great reminder to check our emergency plans and make sure we’re stocked up for any weather surprises. 

It’s a little like checking the pantry before a big meal; you don’t want to be caught off guard. So, have you all tucked away any tips or tricks for handling the heat or storms? Let’s hear them! ☀️
